acceptance: An inventory of benchmarks that can read PASSED without evidence exists, with the owner's decision.
context:
Step of the TPC-DI correction plan. Full plan with file paths and line numbers: local://tpcdi-correction-plan.md (planner report, agent://TpcdiCorrectionPlan). Reviews: agent://TpcdiQuerySetReview, agent://TpcdiRootCause. Generator research: agent://TpcdiDatagenAlternatives. Every owner decision is quoted on tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120. The planner's step numbers (S1..S20) are given for cross-reference only; line numbers in the plan are as of origin/develop ffc4de7750 and must be re-read before editing.

Owner decision 2026-11-22 (choice dialog). Where it conflicts with the Decision gates text in the description, this wins. "produce the inventory and a proposed rule, then stop. It can affect published results."

2026-11-22: inventory and proposed rule written and linked (/Users/joe/.tractable/finding-drafts/benchbox/2026-11-22-no-validation-evidence-inventory.md), read at origin/develop ad4038e1ef and origin/published-results d2be33f732. Inventory: 407 of the 411 published bundles that read PASSED carry no validation evidence (19 benchmarks, 14 platforms; all SQL runs); the 4 with evidence are TPC-H. On develop a new run can still read PASSED with no evidence for 21 of 23 registry benchmarks (exceptions: TPC-DI, fixed; TPC-H power). Cause: PASSED is the default and SQL adapters derive it from load checks; per-query row-count checks run only for TPC-H/TPC-DS power or with --validation postload/full, and only TPC-H, TPC-DS and SSB have reference answers. Proposed rule: 'no validation evidence means not passed' for every benchmark; evidence is a PASSED row_count_validation, a recorded answer comparison, or an exported audit block; otherwise NOT_VALIDATED. Simulated effect: 407 labels change; Explorer ranked results fall from 216 to 2 and ranked cohorts from 44 to 1; the corpus CI check would fail; the 20 benchmarks without reference answers could no longer be published. Open questions for the owner are in the document. No code changed. Blocked for the owner's decision.
description:
## Problem
The first TPC-DI review found that a result with no validation evidence is labelled PASSED. Step 4 fixes it for TPC-DI only.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- "'No validation evidence means not passed' applies to TPC-DI now; the same rule for other benchmarks is filed as a separate item."

## Change
Inventory which benchmarks produce PASSED with no row-count, answer or audit evidence, and how many published bundles that covers. Propose the rule and its effect on the corpus. No code change before the owner decides.

## Decision gates
Owner decides the rule and what happens to affected published bundles before any change.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the inventory (benchmark, evidence kind, published bundle count) is recorded and the owner's decision is quoted here.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
